body.en:
Ethereum is poised to lead the crypto market higher, with a predicted gain of 2.06% for the week, according to the BitPredictable LSTM AI model, which has a confidence level of 90% in this forecast. This upward trend is reflected in recent news, such as the CoinDesk Live updates: Ether leads crypto higher. China's gold imports surge article, which highlights the current strength of [ethereum](/coins/ethereum). In contrast, [bitcoin](/coins/bitcoin) is expected to remain flat, with a predicted gain of only 0.48% and a confidence level of 79%. 

The market is showing a mix of signals, with some coins expected to gain and others to remain flat or decline. [Solana](/coins/solana) is predicted to rise by 0.97%, while [dogecoin](/coins/dogecoin) is expected to fall by 0.67%. The overall picture is one of cautious optimism, with some coins showing potential for growth, but also some warning signs, such as the recent losses suffered by Triple-A, which reported an $11.8 million loss due to a treasury-wallet breach, as reported by [Cointelegraph](https://cointelegraph.com/news/triple-a-treasury-wallet-breach-11-8-million-loss?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound).

## Key Signals This Week

The BitPredictable LSTM AI model is predicting a flat performance for [binancecoin](/coins/binancecoin) and [ripple](/coins/ripple), with gains of 0.07% and 0.39%, respectively. The confidence levels for these predictions are 61% and 70%, respectively. These predictions suggest that the market may be consolidating, with some coins preparing for a potential breakout, while others may be due for a correction. The recent article CoinDesk Crypto is the canary in the coal mine for the quantum computing threat, experts say, highlights the potential risks facing the crypto market, including the threat of quantum computing.

## Trading Agent Update

The Trading Agent, crypto-ace, has had a mixed performance this week, with 8 wins and 7 losses. The cumulative return is -2.87%, and the win rate is 45%. The Sharpe ratio is -5.73, indicating a high level of risk. The agent is currently on a 5-trade losing streak, which is being closely monitored. The agent's performance is a reminder that even with advanced AI models, trading in the crypto market can be challenging and unpredictable.

## What to Watch

As the market continues to evolve, it's essential to keep an eye on the performance of [bitcoin](/coins/bitcoin) and [ethereum](/coins/ethereum), as well as the other major coins. The recent news about South Korea's trading giant putting receivables on-chain in a tokenization test with LG CNS, as reported by [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/07/26/south-korea-trading-giant-puts-receivables-onchain-in-tokenization-test-with-lg-cns), highlights the growing interest in blockchain technology and its potential applications. With the Clarity: State of Crypto event approaching, the market may be due for a significant shift, and traders should be prepared for any eventuality.

This is for informational purposes only and should not be considered as investment advice.

## 注目シグナル
[Ethereum](/coins/ethereum) の上昇と、[Bitcoin](/coins/bitcoin) の安定傾向が注目される。一方、[Dogecoin](/coins/dogecoin) の下落は、投資家がより安定した資産を見つける必要性を高める可能性がある。最近のニュースでは、CoinDesk Live updates: Ether leads crypto higher. China's gold imports surge — https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/07/27/live-updates-ether-leads-crypto-higher-as-bitcoin-trades-around-usd65-500 により、Ethereumの動向が市場のトレンドを形成していることがわかる。

## トレードエージェントの状況
Trading Agent (crypto-ace) の状況を見ると、Cumulative return が -2.87% と赤字に転じている。また、Win rate は 45% と低く、Sharpe ratio も -5.73 と低い水準にある。特に、5 つのトレードで連敗していることが懸念される。ただし、この週のトレードでは 8 回の勝利と 7 回の敗北を記録しており、勝率は 53% である。

## 来週のチェックポイント
来週は、Ethereum と Bitcoin の動向が市場の方向性を決める可能性が高い。特に、CoinDesk Crypto is the canary in the coal mine for the quantum computing threat, experts say — https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/07/27/crypto-is-the-canary-in-the-coal-mine-for-the-quantum-computing-threat-experts-say によると、量子コンピューティングの脅威が暗号資産市場に与える影響が注目される。
